ops.title: 12.69.1: per-hook windows fire on 83 MB transcripts; RanCommand(subagents=True) still reads every teammate transcript
ops.body: 12.69.0 (#224) gives each hook its own transcript_events window; 12.69.1 (#225) evaluates windowed hooks' conditions before full-load hooks so a full acquire cannot spend the 0.75 s tool deadline first. Probe 2026-10-01 ~10:10Z: landing_state_through_ccx (256-event window) fired 3/3 on an 83 MB transcript in 0.2-1.0 s. On the live root transcript 900424b6 it correctly does not fire: skip_if RanCommand('ccx','vcs','status') defaults to subagents=True, and 18 of 830 teammate transcripts ran it. A windowed Session still resolves sidechains under <session>/subagents for subagents=True queries, so window size does not bound that read. Supersedes the open question in 4a58b20; remaining (a) = cc-transcript 14.31.x windowed acquire for every hook.
